definitions.explanation: The governing party (or coalition) and the opposition parties taken together, as in political news about negotiations and votes.

examples.japanese: {与野党|よやとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{対立|たいりつ}している→対立する：22172_tairitsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The ruling and opposition parties are at odds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{与野党|よやとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The bill passed with the support of both the ruling and opposition parties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{与野党|よやとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{党首|とうしゅ}→党首：17742_toushu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{討論|とうろん}した→討論する：25379_touronsuru⟧。
examples.english: Ahead of the election, the leaders of the ruling and opposition parties debated on television.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧ (ruling party) and ⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧ (opposition).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {与野党|よやとう}⟦{協議|きょうぎ}→協議：02635_kyougi⟧: talks between the ruling and opposition parties
- {与野党|よやとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{攻防|こうぼう}→攻防：12925_koubou⟧: the battle between government and opposition
- {与野党|よやとう}⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧: a reversal in which the opposition gains a majority
- {与野党|よやとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わ→問う：02299_tou⟧ず: regardless of party, across party lines
